record_notes.DCP-LETT-1493: December 17, supplied 1852 from December18 postmark; damaged ALS with gaps preserved. Full five blocks, two footnotes and bibliography read. Bosquet letter addressed to Forbes forwarded two or three weeks ago, with request Darwin answer: missing third-party source, not originally Darwin-addressed. Copies now obtained and Bailliere instructed to forward; prospective arrival not completed delivery. Second volume expected next year but actual 1854 publication remains later apparatus. Darwin dissatisfied with fossil volume, more hopeful recent volume; sexual relations recommendation not proof Bosquet read them. Lyell returned few days ago, exact day unspecified.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1515: April15, supplied1853, surviving copy. Full long P1 and closing/P.S., all nine footnotes and bibliography read. Darwin explains six-valve homology, asymmetric development and uncertain left/right identification against missing Bosquet drawings. Own diagrams1/2 explicitly omitted by copyist; later1854 published illustrations are not substitute originals. Raw turga is copyist misreading of terga, retained as source layer. Full figure sequence including apparently inconsistent numbering retained, not silently repaired. Verruca prisca manuscript naming and possible prior Bosquet publication remain provisional; later adopted name not already completed. Proposed examination, questions on breakage and adductor ridge, and speculative Lepas/carinal identifications are qualified. Verruca Stromia enclosed but recipient receipt unknown. Missing April7 input retrospectively identified by1517, not reconstructed from Darwin explanation.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1517: June7, supplied1853 ALS; three blocks, three footnotes and bibliography. Explicitly identifies missing Bosquet April7 drawing letter and follows up unanswered queries from1515. Questions concern adductor plate outline, breakage and movable tergum attrition; no proof of the answer until later inspection. Expects volume soon, not actual publication. Same-author1515 is prior inquiry, never a prompt to Darwin.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1520: June18,1853 copy; all six blocks, eleven footnotes and bibliography. Bosquet letter and fossils received the very next day after dispatch of last enquiry1517. Relative receipt is demonstrated; June8 follows only if June7 composition was also dispatch, not independently proved here. Pretty careful inspection completed but less study than desired. Returns loan valve and sends own scarce broken carina for future return, not transfer of ownership. Darwin agrees most identifications, doubts some valve positions and Scalpellum equivalence; no universal settled agreement. Copyist pisca/prisca, specular/opercular and other garbled terms remain literal with separate editorial readings. Future1854 descriptions or December24 naming regret not inserted into June stance.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1523: July17,1853 copy; all three blocks, six footnotes and bibliography. Written while away despite Down address; apparatus gives Eastbourne stay July14–August4. Missing incoming letter received day before leaving home, not exact date independently certified by address or stay dates. Compared specimen before leaving; some points not yet considered. Accepts close rostro-lateral resemblance, shifts toward four rather than three lateral pairs while maintaining uncertainty. Planned Latin synopsis and autumn publication expectation not completed publication. Postscript separately retained.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1537: October13, supplied1853 copy; two blocks, five footnotes and bibliography. Missing kind letter offers memoir and Balanus valves; one month/six weeks future receipt acceptable, no current manuscript receipt. Printing delayed and expected in three/four weeks, not begun. Requests abbreviated specific characters, may prepare them himself. Two/three hours daily work is Darwin current self-report. Source speciorum and Spauwers?? are copyist errors/indecision, not silently modernised. Fossil Balanus naming queried; later printed identifications remain later evidence.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1543: December24,1853 copy of damaged original; five blocks, ten footnotes and bibliography. Letter/MS received a few days ago, exact date unknown. P2 only part of manuscript read, P5 now half read during same letter: do not equate manuscript availability with full reading. Praises plates, corrects basi-lateral terminology and doubts figure6 identification. Multiple torn-off passages represented by gaps; tagum/speciorum copyist readings preserved, missing prose not filled from later book. P4 regrets not using Mitella but too late to change forthcoming synopsis. Future publication/presentation not current delivery. P.S. half the manuscript not proof all to be published, explicitly supposes.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1548: January19, supplied1854 copy; three blocks, three footnotes and bibliography. Retracts December doubt because fixed tergum projection was broken; identification now clear, specimen return hoped safe. New explanatory Bosquet input/specimen not fully preserved, and own December1543 cannot serve as incoming prompt. P2 now finished manuscript reading, distinct from December partial/half and future completed printed work. Do not substitute this resolution into earlier uncertainty.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1578: August13, supplied1854 ALS; three blocks, five footnotes and bibliography. Two published volumes received day before yesterday, giving August11 under accepted supplied year. Interested in geological distribution remarks is demonstrated selected content reading, not claim every page read. Own volume finished weeks earlier, final revisionJuly15 by diary apparatus; Ray Society publication timing still unknown, copies and Bosquet dispatch future. Septemberpublication remains future. Editorial summary says geographical distribution while body says geological; actual body controls.

reading_method: Root independently read all nine complete surviving transcriptions, source-carrier metadata, dates, exclusions, footnotes and bibliographies. No inline assets present; referenced drawings omitted or missing. Bosquet-sender search across current source catalogue returned no preserved incoming endpoint.
